kurzbeschreibung: The Timmelsjoch Hochalpenstrasse links Tyrol with South Tyrol, impressing travellers with spectacular architecture and the Passmuseum.
beschreibung:
The Secret Gap in the Alps

The Timmelsjoch Hochalpenstrasse is far more than a mere alpine mountain pass. At 2,509 metres altitude, it connects the Tyrolean Ötztal with the Passeier Valley in South Tyrol. The road weaves through dramatic high-mountain landscapes and conquers spectacular hairpin turns.

Architectural Sculptures of the Timmelsjoch Experience

Along the route, five striking architectural sculptures designed by architect Werner Tscholl invite travellers to pause and reflect. The undisputed highlight is the Passmuseum, which cantilevers out over the chasm like a stylised erratic boulder and documents the eventful history of the pass pioneers.
